messages:
lina: Opening PR to update the rate-slab + quota migration guide with fresh JS SDK and curl examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4601 - main goals: clarify slab semantics, show quota header routing examples, and add a small failover snippet. PTAL.

zach: thanks! can we also include the YAML example for quota rules that ops teams can paste into infra-as-code? last time folks copied an old format and hit validation errors.

lina: yes adding a minimal YAML sample and a note about deprecated keys. planned snippet: 
```yaml
quota_rules:
  - name: pro-default
    route: pro
    window_sec: 60
    max_requests: 60000
    burst_credits: 300
```

rachel: add a short sentence explaining "burst_credits" vs "rate_per_minute" so folks don't assume they're equivalent. also include a small example showing how a sustained higher rate consumes both.

lina: good call, will add a micro-example and a quick graph image (anonymized).

zach: for the JS snippet, prefer the new sdk v2 usage pattern. sample we can include:
```javascript
import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-2', prompt: 'hey', headers: { 'X-Quota-Route': 'pro' } });
```

rachel: include a note about server-side header injection and a warning to not rely on client-sent X-Quota-Route without backend validation.

lina: adding that. also adding a curl example for ops: `curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Quota-Route: pro" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

billing-bot: Automated check: removed any hard $/token numbers. Pricing links verified. Please ensure all tier names use canonical slugs.

lina: confirmed - replaced internal names with slugs (free/pro/enterprise). added a short migration note for teams that used old "tier_v1" strings.

docs-qa: i'll run docs-lint + link-checker and post results. also will validate that the YAML conforms to the schema used by infra tools. expect results in ~30m.

sdk-robot: SDK snippet lint: OK for JS, but flagged missing await handling in example. recommend `try/catch` wrapper for production sample.

lina: will adjust to include try/catch and a tiny fallback to a read-only cache when requests are throttled. aiming to merge after QA green. :thumbsup:
